literal_meaning: খুঁটি খুঁটি করে বিস্তারিতভাবে পরীক্ষা করা
figurative_meaning_en: To judge by finding faults or nitpick
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবকিছু খুঁটিয়ে দেখে, কোনো খুঁত ছাড়ে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He nitpicks everything and doesn't let any flaw go unnoticed.
The examiners scrutinized the report in detail.
note: This idiom reflects a meticulous, often overly critical approach common in Bengali discourse.
